_about: The SDK's global pronunciation list (Part 00 §5.4): words every game's reader gets wrong. A game's content/pronunciations.json beats it. Each entry was checked on 2026-09-24 against what the Kokoro sidecar's phonemiser (espeak-ng) actually produces; phonemes marked 'Blanks' were already vetted by Session B's recogniser check in games/blanks/content/pronounce.json. `say` is a lowercase respelling for Zira: espeak spells a capitalised syllable ('YON') letter by letter. Keys match case-sensitively unless anyCase.

COVID.why: espeak says KAH-vid for every casing, and rule 8 would spell COVID (Blanks' phonemes)

LEGO.why: rule 8 spells 2-5 capitals; espeak says 'Lego' right

YOLO.why: rule 8 spells 2-5 capitals; espeak says 'Yolo' right

FOMO.why: rule 8 spells 2-5 capitals; espeak says 'Fomo' right

GIF.why: rule 8 spells 2-5 capitals; said as a word

SWAT.why: rule 8 spells 2-5 capitals; espeak says 'Swat' right

Pokémon.why: with the accent espeak says PAH-kay-mun; without it, POH-kay-mon

jalapeño.why: with the tilde espeak says jal-uh-PEE-nyoh; without it, hah-luh-PAY-nyoh
